scripts.dev: npm run build -w @eval/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c cyan,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @eval/shared" "npm run dev -w @eval/api" "npm run dev -w @eval/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eval/shared && npm run build -w @eval/api && npm run build -w @eval/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @eval/shared && npm run typecheck -w @eval/api && npm run typecheck -w @eval/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @eval/shared && npm run test -w @eval/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run db:validate && npm run typecheck && npm run test
